$comment: Licence policy, attribution obligations and named exceptions. See docs/LICENSES.md and CLAUDE.md §2. Ruled on 2026-08-06. Every exception needs licence, scope, reason and status. The 'licence' field pins what the exception was granted against — if the package changes licence, the audit fails even though an exception exists. NOTICE is regenerated from the real tree on every run; it cannot drift.
$policyNote: BlueOak-1.0.0 and Python-2.0 added 2026-08-06: both permissive with no conditions we cannot meet. CC-BY-4.0 and CC-BY-3.0 added under an explicit condition — CC-BY is not a free pass, it obliges attribution — so every CC-BY package is listed by author and licence link in the generated NOTICE.

exceptions.reason: Approved 2026-08-06 as a named production exception. Prebuilt libvips binary behind sharp, which Next.js uses for image optimisation. sharp itself is Apache-2.0; the LGPL-3.0 part is libvips, used unmodified and dynamically linked, which LGPL permits. The alternative is losing next/image, a worse trade for an image-heavy site. Licence text ships in NOTICE. Platform-specific: other @img/sharp-* binaries appear on other build hosts and need matching entries.
Approved 2026-08-06. As @img/sharp-win32-x64 — WASM build of libvips, unmodified.

Approved 2026-08-06 as a named build-time exception, same reasoning as axe-core. Tailwind CSS v4's stylesheet transformer, pulled by @tailwindcss/postcss. Runs at build time; no MPL-licensed file is modified or distributed.
Approved 2026-08-06. Platform binary for lightningcss; same reasoning.

Approved 2026-08-06 (docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md E1). MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft; the tool is consumed unmodified, is a devDependency, and is never shipped. No obligation triggered. Arrives transitively via eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y, and directly via @axe-core/playwright at M15.
